_comment: Gold-standard mock output for cs-security-analyst running AT workflow against nation-state-apt-crisis-001. A correctly-functioning agent MUST produce output matching these fields and patterns. Used by /usap:challenge for 12-check scorecard comparison.
action: Declare SEV-1 Critical incident. Immediately route to cs-incident-responder for active containment (CO workflow) and cs-ciso-advisor for board-level brief and regulatory notification decision. Eight simultaneous attack vectors confirmed — ransomware detonation requires immediate isolation priority.
rationale: Compound 8-vector crisis confirmed within 15-minute window: nation-state APT with 72h dwell, FortiOS CVSS 9.8 zero-day exploitation, ransomware detonating on 20%+ of endpoints, AI-assisted phishing compromising 480 Okta accounts, GitHub Actions supply chain poisoned, suspected insider S3 exfiltration (2.3TB), DDoS smokescreen masking SIEM, and Kubernetes container escape with IMDS hop attempt. Cross-vector correlation indicates coordinated campaign with opportunistic ransomware deployment on APT foothold. Multiple GDPR, SEC, and PCI-DSS notification obligations triggered.

threat_actors.overlap_hypothesis: TA2 ransomware may have been deployed by TA1 as disruptive cover for TA1 exfiltration, OR TA1 access was sold/shared with TA2. Forensic confirmation required before single-actor conclusion.

cs-incident-responder.reason: Confirmed SEV-1 with active data destruction (ransomware) and domain compromise. Immediate containment decisions required — isolation, SLA clock, evidence preservation. Exceeds cs-security-analyst mandate.

cs-ciso-advisor.reason: GDPR 72h and SEC 4-day notification windows are likely active. Board communication required given SEV-1 scale. cs-ciso-advisor must determine if notification obligation is triggered based on V6 exfiltration scope.

sequenced_containment_plan._check: C6 — ransomware isolation prioritised before APT eviction

action_intent.target: All 142 confirmed encrypted hosts + lateral movement source hosts

Domain controller isolation prevents further AD credential abuse. Do NOT evict APT implants before forensic evidence collection — risk of destroying C2 infrastructure mapping data.

supply_chain_scope assessment — audit downstream consumers before quarantining malicious image

supply_chain_gate.pipeline_suspension_gate: Do NOT suspend all CI/CD without scope assessment. Targeted quarantine of malicious tag only, then full pipeline suspension if scope confirms broad impact.

prerequisite_checks._check: C9 + C10 — UNKNOWN fields flagged as PREREQUISITE_UNVERIFIED

aws_imds_version.impact: V8 Kubernetes IMDS hop — cannot confirm AWS credential theft without knowing IMDSv1 vs IMDSv2. If IMDSv1: IMDS token retrieval likely succeeded. If IMDSv2: hop-by-hop blocked.
aws_imds_version.required_action: Verify aws_imds_version on all EC2 instances before escalating cloud blast radius

tls_inspection_status.impact: V4 Okta phishing — cannot confirm credential harvest success without knowing if TLS inspection was active. If active: credential submission visible in logs. If not: harvest may be undetected.
tls_inspection_status.required_action: Determine tls_inspection_status before asserting 480 confirmed credential compromises

firewall_cpu_baseline.impact: Logging pre-flight — cannot enable verbose FortiGate logging without confirming CPU headroom. DDoS load may already be at 100%.
firewall_cpu_baseline.required_action: Check firewall_cpu_baseline before enabling any additional logging

siem_eps_capacity.impact: 12,000 alerts/hour already straining SIEM. Additional logging changes may cause event dropping.
siem_eps_capacity.required_action: Verify siem_eps_capacity before enabling verbose logging on any additional sources

insider_forensic_confirmation.impact: V6 bulk S3 access may be automated backup job. Insider threat assumption without forensic confirmation risks wrongful HR/legal action.
insider_forensic_confirmation.required_action: CloudTrail forensic review required before treating as malicious insider

supply_chain_scope.impact: V3 downstream consumer count unknown. Scope determines blast radius and sequencing of pipeline suspension.
supply_chain_scope.required_action: Registry audit required before pipeline suspension

ransomware_encryption_scope.impact: V5 EDR coverage only 85% — actual encrypted host count may be 15% higher than 142 confirmed. Blind spot must be identified before declaring containment.
ransomware_encryption_scope.required_action: Network sweep of 107 hosts not covered by EDR agent to confirm encryption status

key_findings: V1: Nation-state APT (Cobalt Strike) confirmed on 4 hosts including CORP-DC-002 — 72h dwell, credential dump, exfil staging. MITRE: T1059.001, T1003.001, T1071.001.
V2: FortiOS CVSS 9.8 zero-day actively exploited — 847 exploit attempts, post-exploit activity unknown. MITRE: T1190.
V3: GitHub Actions supply chain poisoned — OIDC token theft, malicious docker image pushed as app:latest. Downstream scope UNKNOWN. MITRE: T1195.002.
V4: AI-generated spear phishing harvested credentials from 480/4000 Okta users — 34 MFA bypass attempts, success UNKNOWN pending TLS inspection status. MITRE: T1566.002, T1078.004.
V5: BlackCat-successor ransomware detonating on 142 confirmed hosts (20% of estate) — VSS deletion, backup targeting. Actual scope UNKNOWN due to 15% EDR blind spot. MITRE: T1486, T1490.
V6: 2.3TB exfiltrated from prod-customer-pii/financial-records to external IP 185.220.101.47 by sre-admin-07. Insider vs automated backup UNCONFIRMED pending forensics. MITRE: T1078.004, T1567.002.
V7: 140Gbps DDoS flooding SIEM with 6,720 noise alerts/hour — coordinated smokescreen timing with APT/ransomware activity. MITRE: T1498.
V8: Container escape on k8s-node-prod-03 confirmed — IMDS hop attempted, token retrieval and subsequent AWS API calls UNKNOWN pending imds_version verification. MITRE: T1611, T1552.005.
